summary_1line: Narratives recount Basava’s miracles and departure, the life and debates of Pandit Mallikarjuna, and the transformation of poet Malhana through love and devotion to Siva.

image_candidates.scene_text: As Gangamba removes her silk saree to give away, new shimmering sarees miraculously appear again and again on her body.
Mallikarjuna cuts off his own head before the king, yet the severed head miraculously rejoins his body as astonished onlookers watch.
At the temple at dusk, Pushpagandhi and Malhana stand before a Siva shrine as he begins composing devotional verses after renouncing sensual life.
